description: Live Google, News, Scholar, Maps and Bing results, plus rank checks, SERP diffs and cited research briefs.

novel_features.name: Domain rank check
novel_features.description: See the position of a domain for a query, optionally from a specific country, in one call.

novel_features.name: SERP change diff
novel_features.description: See which URLs entered, left, or moved in a results page since the last time you ran the same query.

novel_features.name: Cited research brief
novel_features.description: Get one deduplicated, numbered source list for a topic from web, news and scholar results at once.
